Balaji Amines Limited is a well-established Indian chemical company based at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra. Operating from Solapur, the company specializes in the manufacture and supply of a broad range of specialty and basic amines and other fine chemical intermediates that serve diverse industrial segments including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, dyes and pigments, rubber chemicals, and other specialty chemical applications. With an emphasis on consistent product quality and regulatory compliance, the company integrates modern process technologies with experienced technical teams to deliver products that meet stringent industry specifications.

The company’s manufacturing capabilities typically encompass multi-purpose production facilities designed for flexibility and scalability, enabling the production of both bulk and custom specialty molecules. Quality assurance systems and analytical laboratories support product development and ensure batch-to-batch consistency, while process safety and environmental management are prioritized in plant operations. These practices help Balaji Amines cater to domestic as well as international customers who demand reliable supply chains and compliant products.

Beyond manufacturing, the organization focuses on continuous improvement and innovation—adapting processes to improve yields, reduce impurities, and develop customer-specific formulations or intermediates. Emphasis on occupational health, safety, and environmental stewardship aligns with best practices for chemical producers, and the company typically works to meet or exceed applicable statutory and industry standards.

Serving diverse end-markets, Balaji Amines Limited positions itself as a reliable partner for companies seeking high-quality chemical intermediates from India’s industrial heartland. Located in Solapur with logistical access to regional transport networks, the company leverages its strategic location to support timely deliveries and responsive customer service, while maintaining a commitment to sustainable and safe chemical manufacturing.
